--help.stdout:
Analyze application source code

Usage:
  appcat analyze [flags]

Flags:
  Input & Output:
      -i, --input stringSlice       	Path to application source code or a binary file for analysis. Use a comma-separated list for multiple values: --input <input1>,<input2>,... (default [])
      -o, --output string           	Directory where the analysis results will be stored.

  Source & Target Technologies:
      -c, --capability stringSlice  	Specify capability technologies for analysis. Use a comma-separated list for multiple values: --capability <capability1>,<capability2>,... (default [])
      --list-capabilities           	Display available migration capabilities. (default false)
      --list-os                     	Display available migration target operating systems. (default false)
      --list-sources                	Display available migration source technologies. (default false)
      --list-targets                	Display available migration target technologies. (default false)
      --os stringSlice              	Specify operating systems for analysis. Use a comma-separated list for multiple values: --os <os1>,<os2>,... (default [])
      -s, --source stringSlice      	Specify source technologies for analysis. Use a comma-separated list for multiple values: --source <source1>,<source2>,...(default to all sources from `--list-sources` if not set)
      -t, --target stringSlice      	Specify target technologies for analysis. Use a comma-separated list for multiple values: --target <target1>,<target2>,...(default to all targets from `--list-targets` if not set)

  Analysis Options:
      --analyze-known-libraries     	Enable analysis of known open-source libraries (specified in maven.default.index of AppCAT) during analyzing source code. (default false)
      --custom-maven-settings string	Specify the path to a custom Maven settings file.
      --dry-run                     	Only check if the flags are valid, not running the analysis actually. (default false)
      -m, --mode string             	Set the analysis mode. Must be one of 'issue-only' (detect issues only), 'source-only' (detect issues and used technologies), or 'full' (detect issues, used technologies, and list dependencies). (default full)
      --packages stringSlice        	Specify application class packages to be evaluated. Use a comma-separated list for multiple values: --packages <package1>,<package2>,... (default [])

  Rule Options:
      --code-snips-number int       	Limit the displayed number of incidents with code snippets in a file. 0 means no limit so all incidents with code snippets in a file will be displayed; -1 means no code snippet displayed. (default 0)
      --enable-default-rulesets     	Enable the execution of default rulesets. (default true, use `--enable-default-rulesets=false` to disable)
      -l, --label-selector string   	Apply rules based on a specified label selector expression. Example: ((target=azure-aks || target=azure-container-apps) && source)
      --rules stringSlice           	Specify rule files or directories. Use a comma-separated list for multiple values: --rules <rule1>,<rule2>,... (default [])

  Proxy Settings:
      --http-proxy string           	Define an HTTP proxy URL for downloading OSS libraries from maven repository.
      --https-proxy string          	Define an HTTPS proxy URL for downloading OSS libraries from maven repository.
      --no-proxy string             	Specify URLs to exclude from proxy usage when downloading OSS libraries from maven repository.

  Report & Output Formatting:
      --bulk                        	Combine results when running multiple `analyze` commands in bulk. (default false)
      --context-lines-number int    	Set the number of source code lines included in the output for each detected incident. (default 100)
      --incident-selector string    	Filter incidents based on a custom variable expression. Example: (!package=io.konveyor.demo.config-utils)
      --output-format string        	Choose output format: 'yaml' or 'json'. (default json)
      --overwrite                   	Overwrite the existing output directory. (default false)
      --skip-static-report          	Skip generating a static analysis report. (default false)

Global Flags:
      --disable-telemetry   Disable telemetry
      --log-level uint32    Set the log level. (default 4)
      --no-cleanup          Prevent cleanup of temporary resources after execution.

Examples:
  Analyze a source code directory:
    appcat analyze --input /path/to/source --output /path/to/output

  Analyze a source code directory with specific source and target technologies:
    appcat analyze --input /path/to/source --output /path/to/output --source springboot --target azure-aks,azure-appservice,azure-container-apps

  Analyze a source code directory with additional custom rules:
    appcat analyze --input /path/to/source --output /path/to/output --rules /path/to/rules

  Analyze a source code directory using only custom rules (without default rulesets):
    appcat analyze --input /path/to/source --output /path/to/output --enable-default-rulesets=false --rules /path/to/rules
